method: Two separate authors used the same task with baseline and updated skills; a third author used a fixed-camera transfer task. A separate reviewer saw anonymous outputs and original tasks, without version mapping or source edits.
limits: One output per condition. The baseline was frozen. The updated author read the installed source during maintenance; subsequent edits concerned one-take boundary guidance and historical annotations. Not a statistically controlled or generated-media experiment.
quick_validate: All four edited skills passed the actual skill-creator quick_validate.validate_skill function. PyYAML 6.0.3 was loaded from an isolated task-local QA dependency directory; no global Python packages were changed.

post_review_transfer.review_kind: Workflow author semantic review, not another independent blind review
